title: bibliolatam: Latin American Bibliographic Data Adapters for 'bibliometrix'
description: An R companion package providing parsers, REST API clients, and federated discovery pipelines to adapt Latin American open-access scientific literature (SciELO, BDTD, Oasisbr, Redalyc, LA Referencia, SPELL) into canonical bibliometrixDB data frames compatible with bibliometrix and biblioshiny.
